result.note: Mostly a logistics story; tested only the durable facts of venue, first-in-developing-world status and duration.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the AI Impact Summit that opened in New Delhi in February 2026:
items: It was the first time the global AI summit was held in the developing world.
It was scheduled to run until 20 February 2026.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both are correct. The summit opened on Monday 16 February 2026 and was expected to draw roughly 250,000 attendees through February 20. The government used it to position India as a voice for the Global South on AI policy.
questions.source: This is the first time the global AI summit has been held in the developing world.
